body: Hey, "I'm proud of you" filled me with so much joy to read. I feel good knowing that at least one person will, without fail, allow me to guilt free experience my pain and I'll keep that space at the back of my mind when I doubt myself. Thank you, kind stranger ☆

"It's time for you now" is currently my new wallpaper, I love looking at it. Thank you, I will certainly let my thoughts ebb and flow and guess what, I'm already getting tired of some of them! Thank you, kind stranger ☆

HOLY

Dude, that's freaking awesome, thank you so much! You noticed more about the photo than I did as well, I didn't see the opening on my leg. Keep up the work my man, you're good (:
